profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: As a software engineer with a keen interest in learning and problem-solving, I enjoy using my technical skills to create effective solutions that align with business needs. With experience with various programming languages and frameworks, I'm always looking to expand my knowledge. I'm excited to contribute to a company's success while also seizing opportunities for personal development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-)Utilized NgRx within an Angular framework for robust state management, developing global, component, and signal stores, enhancing application scalability and maintainability.

-)Generated services from YAML files using the Nx console and OpenAPI plugins, efficiently integrating these services into the application's state management system.

-)Successfully diagnosed and resolved a wide range of defects, enhancing system reliability and user experience, covering everything from minor cosmetic issues to critical functional bugs.

-)Developed and implemented user interface components based on Figma design prototypes, ensuring consistency with visual specifications using Angular and Typescript.

company.name: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Used a combination of Angular, Typescript, and HTML to modify pre-existing components and implement support for localization
Utilized AWS resources such as CloudFormation and CodePipeline to assist in the development of a cloud-based infrastructure
Resolved a number of both Front-end and Back-end defects
Experience in both Waterfall and Agile engineering principles
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Java

Test Internet software through GUI, Functional, Back-end, and security testing
